title: When a slice lists its duplicates in Why, have ork flag any other open item with a near-identical title (here S438) so the orchestrator retires it at landing

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261118-134755-11b1, project ork, item S419:

When a slice lists its duplicates in Why, have ork flag any other open item with a near-identical title (here S438) so the orchestrator retires it at landing

Evidence: S419 Why names S421 and S435 as duplicates; S438 is still open in the Direction list with the same title wording

This slice takes over S320's de-duplication part (note of 2026-11-18). Tool feedback filed near-identical slices again and again on 2026-11-17/18, and each was retired by hand: S416, S422, S426, S429, S433, S441 (UI pass renders); S418, S428, S436 (reviewer in plan mode); S419, S421, S435, S438 (prints-nothing Check lines).

Code evidence (2026-11-18):

- ork detects a repeat only by an exact key: `tool-feedback-SLUG-HASH`, the hash of tool, kind and the normalized proposal text (`internal/engine/toolfeedback.go:40-50`), as adj 414 (`feedback.dedupe`, stable-key) decided. A reworded proposal gets a new key and `slicer add` files a new slice (`internal/engine/toolfeedback.go:224-262`). slicer refuses only an exact duplicate title (`slicer add`).
- No slicer command finds near-duplicate titles (`slicer find near-duplicate` and `slicer find "similar title"` in slicer: no matches, 2026-11-18).
- Measured on the 13 titles above against the 25 open ork items (2026-11-18): word-set Jaccard of lower-case content words is at least 0.5 for 4 of the 24 same-family pairs (S419-S438 0.60, S435-S438 0.56, S426-S429 0.71, S418-S436 0.50) and at most 0.24 for any pair across families. A threshold of 0.5 flags the near-identical pairs with no false match in this sample, and misses the reworded ones (for example S416-S422 0.05). Wording alone cannot find every duplicate.
- The engine already holds what it needs: `slicercli.Client.List` (`internal/slicercli/slicercli.go:54`) and `Note` (`internal/slicercli/write.go:210`).

Open owner question: where ork looks for near duplicates and what it does with a match, per the owner's answer to `feedback.near-duplicates`. adj 414 stays: the exact key still skips a repeat.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
Owner decision adj 493: file then note possible duplicates at word-set similarity >= 0.5.

In `internal/engine/neardup_test.go`:
- `TestNearDuplicateTitlesFindsTheMeasuredPairs`: S438/S419, S429/S426 and S436/S418 match at 0.5. S418 was renamed after measurement; use its original proposal preserved in the Why returned by slicer show S418. Other titles come from slicer show. Red: helper absent.
- `TestNearDuplicateTitlesIgnoresOtherFamilies`: S436/S423 do not match; self, done and retired excluded. Red: helper absent.
- `TestNearDuplicateTitlesIsCaseAndPunctuationBlind`: case and punctuation variants match. Red: helper absent.

In `internal/engine/toolfeedback_test.go`:
- `TestToolFeedbackNearDuplicateIsNotedOnTheNewSlice`: real note argv names S419 on the new slice and persisted JSON has near ids. Red: no note or near.
- `TestToolFeedbackWithNoNearDuplicateAddsNoNote`: unlike titles yield no note or near; assert list argv to observe missing wiring before implementation.
- `TestToolFeedbackListFailureStillFiles`: list failure keeps filing and no near; assert list argv before checking advisory behavior.
- `TestToolFeedbackNearDuplicateNoteFailureStillFiles`: note failure preserves filing and near ids; assert actual note attempt. Red: no note.
Existing exact-key repeat tests remain guards.

Review fix: `TestToolFeedbackRepeatAcrossRunsReturnsTheSameItem` supplies a near-match list response and asserts no list or note call on the exact-key repeat. Existing correct guard makes this regression guard initially green; removing `!added.Existing` must fail each new assertion. `docs/state.md` example adds near ids; no product change or new behavior.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests and see each red for the stated reason.
2. Add `NearDuplicateTitles(title, selfID string, open []slicercli.Item, min float64) []string` in `internal/engine/neardup.go`: lower-case, split on every rune outside [a-z0-9], drop one-letter words and a short fixed stop-word list, compute the Jaccard index of the two word sets, and return the ids at or above `min` in list order. `min` is a constant, 0.5 (the measurement in Why).
3. `FileToolFeedback`: after `slicer add` files a new slice, list the target project's open items and add one `slicer note` on the new slice naming the matches; keep the ids on the entry (`near`).
4. A list or note failure is advisory: it never stops filing or the run (adj 413).
5. Docs: `docs/design.md` tool feedback filing (the near-duplicate note, its threshold, adj 493 next to adj 414). Changelog entry with `slicer changelog add S442 --text "..."`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- Titles as close as S419 and S438 are found as near duplicates; titles from different families in the measured sample are not.
- A tool feedback slice whose title is near an open item is filed and gets a "possible duplicate of" note naming it (adj 493).
- A failed slicer list or note never stops a run or a filing.
- The exact-key repeat rule of adj 414 still holds.
- docs/design.md states the rule, the threshold and adj 493.

Commands:
- `go test ./internal/engine -run 'TestNearDuplicateTitles|TestToolFeedbackNearDuplicate|TestToolFeedbackWithNoNearDuplicate|TestToolFeedbackListFailureStillFiles' -v`
- `go vet ./...`
- `go test ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check` exits 0.
- `adj lint` exits 0.
